actions.startNote: Note: after starting, the course status becomes "In Progress" and graduation can begin.

actions.reopenDesc: Move the course from "In Progress" back to "Recruiting"; you can invite/approve students again. Existing enrollments and material records are unaffected.

actions.reopenConfirmLine2: You can invite/approve students again afterward; existing enrollments and material records are unaffected, and the start-course requirements still apply when starting again.
actions.revertDesc: Move the course from "Completed" back to "In Progress", and clear all students' graduation marks and the class rating/testimony.
actions.revertConfirmLine1: The course status will move from "Completed" back to "In Progress". The course's graduation mark, class rating/testimony, and every student's graduation mark will be cleared.
actions.revertConfirmLine2: Graduation emails already sent cannot be recalled. If this course is graduated again later, the same students will receive another graduation email.
actions.archiveConfirmDesc: Archiving hides this course from the default view of the course management list. Enrollment and material data are fully preserved, and it can be unarchived at any time.
actions.unarchiveConfirmDesc: Unarchiving will make this course reappear in the default view of the course management list.
actions.deleteConfirmWarning: This action cannot be undone. Deleting will permanently remove this course and its enrollment records, and may affect students' learning history and certificate eligibility.

seo.defaultTitle: KUA Ministry | Activate Spirit, Abundance & Victory Courses
seo.description: KUA Ministry offers the three-stage discipleship courses Activate Spirit (啟動靈人), Activate Abundance (啟動豐盛) and Activate Victory (啟動得勝) for church and small-group leaders. Online enrolment, material requests and learning progress in one place.

home.heroSubtitle: Activate Spirit · Activate Abundance · Activate Victory — discipleship course platform
home.featureCourseDesc: Manage sessions and enrolment for 啟動靈人, 啟動豐盛, 啟動得勝 and more.

courses.metaDescription: Learn about KUA Ministry's three-stage courses 啟動靈人 / 啟動豐盛 / 啟動得勝: content, who they are for, and how to enrol.
courses.introHeading: 啟動靈人 · 啟動豐盛 · 啟動得勝 — Course Overview
courses.introBody: KUA Ministry is a progressive discipleship training programme made up of three stages — 啟動靈人 (Activate Spirit), 啟動豐盛 (Activate Abundance) and 啟動得勝 (Activate Victory) — for Christians, small-group leaders and church co-workers who long to grow. 啟動靈人 helps you know and experience the presence of the Holy Spirit; 啟動豐盛 builds you up in gifts and service; 啟動得勝 equips you to stand firm in spiritual battle and lead others.
courses.noCourses: No courses are open for enrolment right now. Please check back for updates.

fallback.啟動靈人: The 啟動靈人 course leads students to know the Holy Spirit and practise a Spirit-led life; suitable for new or renewing believers.
fallback.啟動豐盛: The 啟動豐盛 course builds students who have completed 啟動靈人 in gifts, character and service toward an abundant life.
fallback.啟動得勝: The 啟動得勝 course equips students to stand firm in spiritual battle, experience breakthrough and lead others to victory.
